standard_prerequisites: the equivalent conditions of lemma-equivalent-with-artin (same chapter) for the completed algebra B^wedge

NL^wedge_{B^wedge/A} is the completion (derived completion) of NL_{B/A} (lemma-NL-is-limit of the same chapter)

core_obligations: Prove: (1) if Spec(B) -> Spec(A) is etale over Spec(A) minus V(I), then B^wedge satisfies the equivalent conditions of lemma-equivalent-with-artin; (2) conversely, if B^wedge satisfies those conditions, there exists g in 1 + IB such that Spec(B_g) is etale over Spec(A) minus V(I)
proof_roadmap: Direction (2): the rig-etale condition gives c >= 0 with H^{-1}/I^nH^{-1} and H^0/I^nH^0 annihilated by I^c for all n; by Nakayama a single element g = 1 + x with x in IB annihilates I^cH^{-1} and I^cH^0; inverting g does not change the quotients B/I^nB and makes the cohomology of NL_{B/A} annihilated by I^c, so A -> B_g is etale at all primes over the complement of V(I).

Direction (1): etale over the complement means for every a in I some power a^c annihilates the cohomology of NL_{B/A}; since NL^wedge_{B^wedge/A} is the derived completion of NL_{B/A} quoted from lemma-NL-is-limit, B^wedge satisfies the equivalent conditions of lemma-equivalent-with-artin.
difficulty_reason: H3: a cotangent-complex equivalence whose core is a Nakayama step producing the localizing element g plus a derived-completion step in the other direction.
